{{Quote|I will ''not'' be undermined by creatures bred in some ''laboratory''!|[[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], to his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]|<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>}}
A '''laboratory''' was a type of science facility, often standardized and used for experiments.
